Photo by Emiliano Vittoriosi on UnsplashThe question that many people asked for the past few years was, "Which model is the best?"
Now the latest OpenAI direction says that question is incorrect. OpenAI just created a family of AI models with different capabilities, instead of building a single AI model that does everything.
The idea is to provide the users the flexibility to choose the right model to find the balance of capability, speed, and cost based on the task. This shift is about the new variant of GPT, GPT-5.6, and its new variants.
GPT-5.6 Is More Than Just a Better Model
GPT-5.6 is better than the previous models, as it delivers better performance across various fields like coding, writing, research, and computer-based tasks. It is also designed to be faster, more efficient, and safer.
But the real story isn’t just that GPT-5.6 is being more capable; rather, it is about how OpenAI is producing its latest AI models. Instead of making one model do all the work, GPT-5.6 offers multiple variants specifically designed for different workloads.
